qs.q: The rate of refraction of a radio wave which occurs within the ionosphere:
o: decreases as the frequency of the radio wave increases
increases as the frequency of the radio wave increases
qs.ex: The book's grid prints (b). Refraction in the ionosphere gets weaker as frequency rises — that is why the skip distance and dead space grow with frequency (Q5) and why HF frequency is halved at night.
